verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API with full programmatic access to feature flags, plus an official MCP server that lets LLM coding assistants create and manage flags. Change requests can require an approval step before any change lands in an environment such as production, and environment-scoped configuration and RBAC support gating agent writes. missing for 10: explicit documentation that API/MCP-initiated changes are routed into change requests rather than applied directly, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on plan gating, since change requests appear tied to the hosted/enterprise offering.
